ess_definition.form: Maynard Smith two-condition (pure-strategy, single-population, possibly asymmetric A)

diagonal_undefined_policy.rule: If A[i,i] is non-finite, enumerate_pure_ess raises ValueError. The ingest layer raises earlier; this is defence in depth.
diagonal_undefined_policy.reason_currently_inactive: non-terminating cells are resolved by NonTerminationPolicy before A is built, so no diagonal sentinel survives ingest.

tolerance.rationale: payoffs are exact combinations of {b, -c, b-c, 0}; tolerance guards against float-arithmetic noise only
